snippet.title: Fast & Furious: Arcade Edition - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience Fast & Furious: Arcade Edition on console - Available Now!

The ultimate pick-up-and-play racer where pure arcade thrills meet console! Drift, boost, and dominate across cinematic tracks packed with shortcuts, stunts, and over-the-top missions. Bring the arcade home and race legendary cars like the Dodge Charger, Corvette Z06, and Shelby GT500 KR in adrenaline-fueled arcade chaos.

Available Now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S!
#fastandfurious  #ArcadeEdition @TheFastSaga
